NEXT WEEKEND IN BRISTOL 🧡
19–20 September: three free ways to get making at the South Bristol Arts Trail.

🪐 MAKE A SHINY PLANET
Saturday 19 September, 11am–1pm
Colourful Minds, Tobacco Factory Stretch Tent
Foil, collage and colourful pens for little makers.

🎭 MAKE YOUR OWN CHARACTER
Saturday 19 September, noon–2pm
Let’s Make Art, The Southville Centre
A family workshop using colourful materials to create character masks.

🎨 TRY SCREEN PRINTING
Saturday 19 & Sunday 20 September, noon–4pm
Print Paradiso, 137 East Street
Have a go at pulling your own print.

All three are free, drop-in workshops. No numerical age limits are listed; our pick is children roughly 5–12 with a grown-up, with younger makers needing more help. Stay with your children. Space and materials may be limited.

Choose a stop that suits your family — you don’t have to do the whole trail. The wider event runs 11am–5pm across Southville, Bedminster and Ashton.

Save this for next weekend and follow @donext_bristol for more local family plans.

Organiser programme: southbristolarts.co.uk/workshops-performances/
Map and access: southbristolarts.co.uk/visit/
DoNext Bristol: donext.co.uk/bristol/
Details checked 13 September; check the organiser before travelling.

## Higher editorial standard

Updated the existing daily draft task, preserving its draft-only scope and schedule. Research targets: 8–12 credible distinct candidates per city, producing 4–6 strong weekend choices and 2–3 weekday options when supportable. Seek at least three organisers/venues, ages 0–4 / 5–8 / 9–12, mostly free/low-cost, one indoor option, and a mix of nature, active play, science/making and performance/story-led outings. Routine library sessions are useful backups, not the default whole edition. Never invent or dilute quality to meet a numerical target.

Recommended editorial output: 4–5 useful feed posts per city per week, including a Friday roundup and distinct weekday finds. Stories can carry short reminders when a supported publishing route and current content are available; no Story delivery was set up here. Measure saves, shares, city-site clicks and signups, not simply number of posts. Avoid rephrasing the same event as a supposedly new discovery. More cities should follow the working Bristol process once content quality is repeatable.

This file does not enable recurring posting. This one Bristol carousel is authorised separately; Cardiff/Birmingham remain drafts and email delivery remains inactive.
